$sources: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.5.15 designs nonstructural components by an amplified height formula and gives no floor response spectra

SAEngine practice where BNBC 2020 is silent: in-structure spectra by time history or the direct spectrum-to-spectrum method (random vibration), peaks broadened ±15 % (ASCE 4-16 Ch 6, US NRC Regulatory Guide 1.122 practice); see VERIFY.md
source: SAEngine practice where BNBC 2020 is silent (Part 6 Sec 2.5.15 gives the component forces by height only): floor response spectra by time history or the direct method, broadened ±15 % (ASCE 4-16 Ch 6 practice)

sources.broadening: SAEngine practice: ±15 % peak broadening of in-structure spectra (ASCE 4-16 Sec 6.2, US NRC RG 1.122)
sources.components: SAEngine practice: Fc = Sa_floor(Tc) Wc Ic / Rc within the Sec 2.5.15 least and largest force; rigid components (αc = 1) at Tc = 0.06 s, flexible ones (αc > 1, period not entered) at the spectrum's peak
